batting.name: Q de Kock

batting.name: PN Mankad

batting.name: RG Sharma

balls.text: Stoinis finishes it in style. Madhwal misses his yorker and ends up bowling it in the slot for Stoinis. The bottom hand comes off, as it has many times tonight, but he still manages to clear a leaping Tim David, who got fingertips on it. But looks like he fell on his shoulder. He is on the lying ground, and looks in pain as his team-mates gathers around him
Dropped by Jordan. Full outside off, and Pooran scythes it towards deep cover. Jordan charges in, dives forward but ends up spilling it
goes for a leg-stump yorker but ends up straying down the leg side
full on the pads and Pooran swings hard at it. Didn't middle it but got enough on it to beat deep square leg to his left
a low full toss around off and middle. Stoinis fails to middle it as he hits it towards long-off
full down the leg side once again. Pooran gets some pad on it as he looks to flick. Kishan does well to collect it down the leg side. The batters collect a leg-bye
full but way down the leg side
goes for the wide yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss. Pooran, though, fails to get bat on it
full and slow wide outside off. Stoinis looks to pull it but misses altogether. However, he has reviewed it in the hope of a wide. It was well inside the guide line, though
this is carnage. A slower one into the pitch this time. Stoinis was waiting on the back foot and pulls it over square leg. It's a short boundary as well on that side
another slower one. This time a low full toss outside off and Stoinis goes over long-off. The bottom hand came off and it seemed he hadn't really timed it but it goes all the way
a third slower yorker on the trot. Pooran gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls towards covers. The umpire, though, signals leg-bye
another slower yorker. Worked towards long-on
starts with a slower yorker. Worked towards midwicket for one
another boundary to finish the over. Was short and down the leg side. Stoinis helps it to the left of short fine leg. That makes it 24 runs off the over. It could be a game-changing one
Jordan goes for the yorker this time but misses his length. Stoinis stands still and just punches it over long-on
a slower one and Stoinis goes over backward point this time. The sweeper had no chance to stop it
four more. Short on middle and leg, and Stoinis just pulls it towards deep square leg boundary
length ball at the stumps. Pushed back towards the bowler
brings up his fifty in style. A length ball from Jordan and Stoinis just extends his arms through it. Sends it into the stands beyond long-on
length ball around off. Dragged towards deep midwicket
hard length at the batter. Stoinis mistimes the pull towards square leg and sets off. The fielder aims for the direct hit - Stoinis had given up - but misses and concedes an overthrow

nails a yorker, hits the batter on the back shoe. An appeal for lbw and it's given. Stoinis wants to review this. The ball was tailing in, and from the replay, it looks like it brushed the front shoe as well. And the ball-tracking says it was tailing so much that it would have missed the leg stump. So Stoinis survives
length ball around off. Pushed towards long-off
a slower ball around off. Hits it towards long-on
length outside off. Pushed through covers for one

length outside off. Looks to steer it between backward point and short third but ends up it just to the left of backward point. Stoinis sends back Krunal who makes it hobbling. And he is walking out retired hurt
full, in the slot and Stoinis frees his arm. Launches over long-on for a six
length ball around off. Dragged towards deep midwicket. Krunal is hobbling
another slower one. Full on the stumps. Stoinis moves across and looks to flick it fine. Gets a leading edge onto the body and the ball rolls towards square leg
a slower bouncer, at 127.1kph. Comes in to the batter who looks to ramp it over in the end but fails to connect. Called one for the over
moves across early but Green follows him. Krunal looks to go leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Collects a leg-bye
short of length around off. Chopped towards backward point. There was a collision between Krunal and Jordan as both were ball-watching
a low full toss outside off. Stoinis flicks it towards deep midwicket
121,6kph. Short of length but way outside off. Left alone. This time there's no doubt that it's a wide
full outside off. Looks to jam it out but gets beaten
short, angling down the leg side. Krunal goes for the pull but ends up dragging towards short fine leg
short of length outside off. Cuts it to the right of Green who can make only a partial stop
full around off. Driven towards deep extra cover

short of length outside off. An offcutter. Stoinis leaves it alone, thinking it will be called a wide, and it has been called a wide. Mumbai, though, want to review it. Stoinis had moved slightly towards the off side. A bit of confusion out there, and eventually the umpire stretches his arms. Mumbai have lost their review
short of length outside off. Worked towards long-on off the back foot. Hundred comes up for LSG
full around off, almost i the blockhole. Digs it out towards wide long-off
bangs in short seeing Krunal was looking to come out of his crease. Krunal goes for the pull but the ball sneaks underneath the bat
length ball around off, cuts it to the right of the backward point who makes a tumbling stop
full around off. Driven towards wide long-off and they hare back for the second
Stoinis uses his feet now but Madhwal follows him. Pushed towards extra cover
length ball outside off. Gives the charge and hits it towards extra cover. Wadhera looks to throw the ball even before he could get a hold of it. Ends up conceding an extra run
length ball on the stumps. Worked towards deep midwicket for one
a slower length ball but a bit too outside off. Left alone
length ball around off. Cuts it away for one
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards deep square leg
length ball at the stumps. Was a slower ball. Krunal waits for it before pulling it towards long-on
short of length outside off. Krunal moves across and works it towards midwicket for a couple
length ball around off. Punches it towards backward point and sets off
122.4kph. Slower again from Green. Pushed towards long-on
length around off. Another slower ball. Stoinis gets a leading edge towards backward point this time
length outside off. Stoinis says leg side of the ball and cuts it through point, to the left of the sweeper cover
126kph. A slower one on a length around off. Stoinis looks to defend but the ball finds the inside edge rolls towards square leg
length ball around off and middle. Defended back
length ball outside off. Swept towards deep square leg
another legbreak. Much shorter this time but turns big. Stoinis looks to push at it from the back foot but withdraws his bat at the last movement
beaten! A length ball around off, bowled from wide of the crease. Stoinis comes forward and looks to drive but gets beaten by the turn. Kishan breaks the stumps but Stoinis was always in his crease
a legbreak around off. Krunal goes back and cuts it to the left of short third for one
tossed up on the stumps. Pushed towards midwicket gently. Chawla himself puts in the chase but cannot stop the second
full and wide outside off. Krunal jumps out of his crease and launches it over long-off for a big six - 89 metres
length ball on the stumps. Pandya was looking to move towards the leg side but the bowler follows him. Pushed towards long-on
length ball around off. Punched towards extra cover
length ball on the stumps. Pandya moves across and flicks it past midwicket for a couple. The sweeper cuts it off
length ball around off. Stoinis gets a leading edge on it as he looks to push it down the ground. A single to cover
short of length at the stumps. Krunal pulls it towards long-on for one
length ball outside off. Chopped towards mid-off
length ball on the stumps. Goes back and flicks it to the right of short fine leg
length outside off. Goes for the cut but ends up chopping it to the left of short third
it's the shorter boundary on Stoinis' leg side but it doesn't really matter as he sends it into the stands. Was a length ball around off and he sweeps this one for a six
tossed up on the stumps. Krunal digs it out towards long-on
A low full toss on the stumps. Another sweep towards deep square leg to pick up two
full but down the leg side. Swept to the left of deep-backward square leg for two runs
length ball on the stumps, punched towards long-on. Fifty comes up for LSG
length outside off from around the wicket. Turn and bounce. Krunal gets on the top of it and cuts it down towards deep point. The call is for two and gets it comfortably
bowls flatter around off this time. Stoinis goes back and flicks it through square leg
into the stands. Dances down the ground and hits it with the spin, over wide long-on. 89 metres
length ball on the pads. Looks to work it on the leg side but misses. Collects a leg-bye though as Kishan fields the ball
length outside off. Dragged towards deep-backward square leg with a sweep
tossed up outside off. Too full, Stoinis digs it out towards wide long-off
length ball around off. Defended back towards the bowler from the back foot
length ball on the stumps. Punched towards wide long-on but will get only one
length ball, Stoinis gets a single to backward square leg this time. Off the mark
length outside off, Stoinis looks to sweep it. Ends up dragging it towards backward square leg

and he strikes first ball. It was a googly, pitching full around off. De Kock went for the drive only to edge it to Kishan. A mild appeal, followed by even milder celebrations after the finger goes up
length around off, goes back and tries to go hard at it but finds extra cover
length outside off. Cuts it to the right of backward point. Green puts in a dive but can make only a partial stop. By the time Chawla chases it and sends in the throw, the batters have completed two
length ball around off. Extra bounce too this time. Pushed towards cover-point
length ball around off. Krunal waits for it before guiding it towards backward point
length around off. Comes forward and pushes it towards covers. A bit of a hesitation between the two batters but the fielder misses a direct hit at the bowler's end
length ball at the stumps from around the wicket. De Kock backs away and hits it towards wide mid-off
another slower one. 117.9kph. De Kock flat-bats it to the right of mid-off for one
length ball angling towards the off stump. There's hardly any room for de Kock to free his arms as he chops it towards backward point
length ball on the stumps. Looked like another slower ball. Krunal moves across and helps it towards square leg
tucked towards square leg for one this time
a slower one but de Kock goes with his shot and launches it over mid-off. The bottom hand came off but he timed it well enough to hit the boundary cushion on the full - 71 metres
length ball angling towards the batter. De Kock looks to punch through cover-point but gets cramped
short of length outside off. Krunal goes for the cut but finds backward point. He is annoyed with himself for missing out on a boundary opportunity
length ball around off, a little bit of turn. Punched towards point off the back foot
length ball on the pads, flicked towards deep midwicket for a couple
length ball on the stumps, pushed back towards the bowler off the back foot
length ball around off, comes forward and blocks
Shokeen starts with a full ball on the stumps and it's been driven through covers for four
an excellent stop by mid-on, diving to his right. Was full on the stumps and Pandya pushed it down the ground
length ball angling towards the pads. De Kock was looking to work it on the leg side but misses. The get a leg-bye as the ball drop towards the off side
length ball around off, a slower one bowled at 111.5kph. De Kock defends it back
length ball on the pads, tucked away towards deep-backward square leg for three - that's the longer side
Two in two for Behrendorff. A length ball angling across the right-hander. Mankad chases it tentatively, gets an outside edge and Kishan does the rest

David makes no mistake this time. Hooda gives charge to Behrendorff but is still some distance away from the pitch of the ball. He goes for the shot, the ball hits high on the bat and goes up towards mid-on. A simple catch for David on this ocassion
full on the pads and de Kock goes big. Launches it over deep-backward square leg for the first six of the night
a slower one. Full around off. De Kock digs it out back towards the bowler
short of length outside off. Punched towards cover-point
length ball around off, a leading edge behind point for one
short of length around off. Hooda defends it towards covers off the front foot

full around off and Hooda goes aerial. More height than distance on this. David ran back and sideways 28 metres from mid-off and looked to catch it over his shoulder, reverse cups. The ball though bursts through his hands and hit him on the chin
length ball around off. Tapped towards cover-point. De Kock sets off immediately but Hooda sends him back. Just three singles from the over
length ball on the pads, swinging in. Flicked towards deep midwicket. It's the shorter boundary that side
full around off once again. De Kock punches it between the stumps and the non-striker for one. Didn't middle it though
full outside off. A bit of shape away from the left-hander. De Kock pushes it towards extra cover
length ball on the pads. Tucked away behind square leg. Hooda and LSG are off the mark
starts with a full one outside off. Pushed towards extra cover

Slower full ball outside off, he only gets it off the inner half through square leg. David hares back for two, even as Pooran picks the ball and nails a direct hit at the striker's end. Referred upstairs, David is just about in, doesn't drag his bat but plonks it in. Uff! LSG eke out a 5-run win!
Mohsin gets the yorker outside off again. Digs it out towards cover. Mohsin has his arms aloft already. He only has to ensure he doesn't overstep.
Nails the yorker, Mohsin! Green fails to dig that out outside off.
Full and angling away, David slices it to deep cover.
Length ball in line of the stumps, he heaves it away to deep midwicket.
Back of a length on middle and leg, it is the offcutter at 122.9 kph. Green only manages to hit it back to the bowler, who is on his haunches.
Why bother about wides when you can do this! Full and outside off, he goes across and smacks it straight over the non-striker for a maximum.
Length ball well outside off, he once again misses the heave across the line. Mumbai have reviewed it. The ball does pass outside the tramline but David is standing well outside off. Not called wide.
David misses! Length ball outside off, he gets back and across and looks to tonk it. Does not make contact.
It slips off his hands. And goes through de Kock who gets a bad bounce. It is a high full toss and he misses the heave.
Drills it back down and Green sprints back for two. This is full outside off, David walks across and hits it back.
Power and distance! This is all muscle. Offcutter in the slot outside off, he is standing around off and middle. Swings his arms and deposits it well over wide long-on.
Yorker outside off, he looks to heave it over the on side but misses.
Very full outside leg, he whips it through square leg and sprints back for two. End of the nine-ball over.
Once again a yorker, but this one's down leg, Green stays put and lets it be.
Nails the yorker yet again. Sees Green backing away and he bowls it very full outside leg. He can't dig that out.

Pooran, calm and collected as he can be, takes a well-judged catch! Celebrations go up in the LSG camp. Thakur banged it short, Vinod goes for the pull and seems to have connected it well. Pooran, though, has enough time at deep square leg to set himself and jumps to catch that.
Nails the yorker. Only manages to flick it to deep midwicket. Not in the gap. Just one. 144.8 kph.
Short down leg, he gets inside the line and pulls it to deep square leg. He has overstepped! The hooter goes off.
Short and into the body, swivels and pulls it to deep square leg.
Yorker down leg, he misses the flick.
Fuller around middle and angling towards off, Vinod looks to play the reverse but misses and it goes off his pad towards cover.
Yorker well outside off, he gets across but fails to get bat on that. Good end to the over.
Fetch that! Offpace short ball slanting away, David goes deep in his crease and swings for the isles. Connects and it flies over deep midwicket.
Length ball angling away, the offcutter, David slashes but misses.
Back of a length and angling away, David lets it go. Given wide.
Short and outside off, he only finds covers with the slap.
Angled away on a length, he punches it through point.

Wadhera finds deep square leg! Mohsin has his arms aloft. Short ball, perhaps the wise choice given he has the longer leg side to bowl to. Wadhera sees the opportunity and pulls it. Doesn't get the distance and finds substitute Gowtham
Fuller outside off, off-pace ball, Wadhera can only power it to long-off. Could have been a wide had he left it

Excellent running gets them two. It is a yorker gone wrong, a full toss at 133.9 kph. Wadhera slices it hard as deep backward point gets around. They spot that the wicketkeeper is not near the stumps plus the fielder in the deep has to balance before throwing and hare back for two.
Bangs it short outside off, it is the offcutter again at 114 kph. David pulls it to deep square leg.
Slower length ball well outside off, he gets across and heaves it to long-on.
Slower one on a length outside off, he has to wait a touch and glides it to backward point.
Full on off, gets behind it and drives it to long-on.

Gets hold of that alright! Short in length, offcutter. Picks up the length early and heaves it away through midwicket. Sams is not deep on the ropes but gets around, dives but gets the ball with the momentum he has over the cushions.
Fuller and just outside off, he looks to glide it and run but gets beaten. Thakur puts in an appeal. Perhaps went off his pad to the wicketkeeper.
Banged short in line of the stumps, he ducks and it passes well over his head.
Short on off, doesn't climb much. Wadhera goes for the bull but is hit high on the back thigh.
Outside off on a length, goes back to punch it through cover.

Oh my word! Was he batting all along? Gets a short ball around off, David goes back and pulls it in front of square on the on side. Deep midwicket and deep square leg converge, with the former putting in the dive but fails to reach the ball.

Thakur gets SKY! Massive strike that and he is rightly pumped up. It is bowled on a length outside off at 120.5 kph. Suryakumar gets across to play the scoop over short fine leg. But because there's not enough pace on the ball, he is through with the shot a tad early. As a result, gets a thick inside edge onto the stumps. He sits disappointed next to the stumps, before getting up and walking back.
Goes back to pat it towards cover for a quick one.
Off the inner edge  through midwicket. Looks to go through covers but the googly means that it rolls through the on side.
Shortish and outside off, goes back and slaps it through covers.
Floated on a length around middle, looks to slog but misses. It bounces just over the off pole.
Excellent hand speed. Shortish, not too short. Quicker as well at 101.6 kph. Wadhera quickly gets under it and heaves it through square leg.
Quicker around middle, he lunges and blocks it towards cover.
Bowls it full in line of the stumps, he watchfully pats it back to the bowler. Just one from Krunal's final over.
Fuller around off, gets forward and pushes it to cover.
Fuller on middle, whipped through midwicket for one.
Fuller on middle and off, flicked to short midwicket.
Fullish outside off, chops it to the off side.
Fires it down leg, Wadhera gets inside the line and looks to play it fine but misses. Not called wide, the keeper does well.
Low full toss on the pads, worked away through wide mid-on.
Fuller and it skids on, he goes back to cut but misses again.
Quicker and fuller, angling away. Goes on with the arm, past the attempted drive.
Quicker and fuller on middle, goes back and turns it through square leg.
Fuller outside off, knocks it down to long-off to get going.

Bishnoi now has both the openers! Googly on a short of a length, Kishan once again tries to use the slowness of the surface to go back and play the pull shot. Ends up heaving it aerially to Naveen-ul-Haq, who gets to his left from deep midwicket. Arms up in celebration for Bishnoi.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket.
Quicker on a length outside off, he goes back and punches it through cover-point.
Fires it fuller on the pads, he crouches and pulls it through backward square leg.
Second boundary in the over. Slower through the air but it is on a length. Allows Kishan enough time to go back and heaves it over midwicket.
Goes back to the length ball and punches it to the bowler.
Kishan picks the length early and takes full toll. A tad short around leg, he goes back and heaves it to been deep backward square leg.
Floats it fuller around off, he lunges and bunts it.
Quicker and fuller on the pads, whips it through midwicket to get going with a couple.

And Bishnoi gets Rohit to hole out. Slower through the air this time, on a length around off and middle. Rohit gets down on a knee and slogs it over the on side. Doesn't get it off the middle and Hooda gets around from long-on and takes it comfortably.
Quicker and flatter down leg, left alone.
Sweeps it well over short fine leg. On a length around off, he gets down and gets it well over the fielder in the ring.
On a length on the pads, he goes back and whips it away through midwicket.
Quicker and outside off, he goes back and cuts it forward of point for a couple.
Goes back and keeps it out to the right of the non-striker.
Fuller on leg, he charges down and hacks it to long-on.
That's a horrible collision. Bishnoi and Swapnil the men in the deep. And the ball goes away to the ropes. Kishan sweeps it and almost finds the perfect gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg
Now Badoni has to run the other away, to his left. Almost over-runs it due to the spin. Dives and keeps it down to one. Rohit plays the sweep again through forward square leg.
Fuller around middle and leg, lunges and defends it down.
Quicker and fuller on off, he sweeps it through backward square leg. Badoni in the deep runs to his right, dives and keeps them down to two.
Full outside off, he drills it back down. Hooda does well to get around from long-off and keep them down to two.
Quicker and the length ball angling down leg, he goes back and clips it through square leg.
Floats it full outside off, he drills it past the non-striker.
Length ball that pitches outside leg, he goes back pushes it back to the bowler.
Angles it in on a length, he goes back and turns it through midwicket.
Begins with a googly on a length, he goes back and keeps it out to cover
Fuller around off, comes down and pushes to cover.
Another half-tracker, duly punished. In line of the stumps, allows him enough time to go back and pull it through square leg.
Goes back and punches it through mid-off.
Outside off, he pats it in front of square on the off side and sprints to the other end.
Shortish and outside off, Kishan goes back and pulls it through midwicket. Such is the placement that he beats deep midwicket running to his right. Wasn't too short actually, but he adjusts well.
Floated full on middle and leg, worked away through mid-on.
Short and he pulls it to deep square leg.

Six! Or a dropped catch? Think Bishnoi misjudged it for starters. Came in for the catch before back-pedaling to catch that. But the momentum took him back and he landed on the cushion before letting go of the ball. Short ball, Rohit played the pick-up almost too well to the fielder.
Low full toss outside off mistimed to mid-off.
Full and outside off, smashes it straight to cover.
Backs away but gets back in position, gets a slower one full on middle and leg, chips it towards mid-on.
Banged it short outside off, Rohit sways away. Wide called.
Very full on leg, he whips it along the ground to mid-on.
Slower length ball angling in, whips it through backward square leg
Short and outside off, slower one, he waits and pulls it to deep square leg.
Backs away but gets a quick length ball that cramps him. He punches it towards point, where even a misfield doesn't see the batters cross.

And Rohit moves across to whip it to the on side. Deep square leg? What's that, Rohit seemingly asks. It is the slower one at 110.8 kph, full length too. But he gets across quickly, in position, and whips it all the away over the fielder.
Short and follows Kishan, who backs away, but he adjusts and pulls it to deep backward square leg. 115.2 kph that ball.
Back of a length ball outside off, he looks to ramp it but misses.
Bangs it short outside off, not a full-blooded pull but almost a steer, through square leg.
Full and outside off, swings at that but misses.

Kishan goes aerial but Pooran does well to keep them down to two. Fuller around off at 117.5kph, Kishan swings it high over mid-on. The ball plugs in the outfield and they take two only, because of Rohit's foot.
Yorks Rohit who was backing away, he gets his bat down to squeeze it out. Hits hit foot in the process and hobbles to the other end.
Well bowled. Deceives Rohit with a change of pace. Bowls it short but it is an offcutter - strangely shows 134.5 kph on the speedometer. Rohit goes for the pull but is done in by the lack of pace.
On a length just outside off, Rohit stays put in the crease and defends.

And Rohit welcomes him with a meaty blow! Charges down almost before Thakur releases the ball. And to his delight, it is a short ball that sits up nicely even after Rohit's down the track. Heaves and deposits it over deep midwicket.
Anticipates the charge down and bangs it short, Kishan comes down but has to adjust and glides it to backward point.
Fuller on off, lunges and opens the face to get it to backward point.
Slashes and slashes hard! Kishan charges down, then backs away to manufacture width against the length ball outside off. He then swings at that to get it over cover-point.
Full and outside off, he flicks it  to long-on for one.
Full on off, it is the slower one at 108.4 kph. He pushed it towards covers for a quick one. Badoni there dives but the single is on.
Full on off and middle, Rohit flicks it with soft hands wide of mid-on.
Oh dear! That's timed and placed perfectly. Misdirected delivery though. Full and on the pads again, Kishan flicks it through the on. Has done well to beat deep square leg to his left.
Full and slides down leg, he looks to flick but doesn't make contact. Pace - 124.1 kph.
Fuller on the pads, it is the slower one. He looks t o flick but misses and is hit on the front pad that is completely out of the line of the stumps.
Angles it away on a length, Rohit moves across and just glides it to deep third.
Full on leg, drives it to mid-on and sets off. The fielder fumbles and doesn't collect on the first go.
Hugeee! Full and on the pads, Kishan has a firm base and just whips it well over deep backward square leg.
Length ball around off, goes back and defends that.
Floated fuller on the stumps, he slinks down and flicks it to deep midwicket.
In line of the stumps, works it away through midwicket to get going.
Comes down but is deceived by the length, manages to push it towards mid-on for a quick one.
Quicker and on a length on middle and leg, goes back and whips it to square leg.
Gift! Fuller and down leg, Kishan gets down on a knee and sweeps it well past short fine leg. Just the start they wanted.
Fuller on the pads, he lunges and defends it back.
